rv.q: The show is a bona fide buffet of beautiful music, offering just a sample of the many superb songs that Mr. Sondheim created.
Each of the ensemblists has a clear, powerful voice, creating the perfect canvas for which to display the complex and varied works of Sondheim.

cn.t: Critics praise this reverent celebration of Broadway's master composer-lyricist, with both reviewers highlighting Sondheim's unparalleled influence and the richness of his musical catalog.
